Chat, browse the web and keep useful information in one place

What you send, including pages the assistant reads in the built-in browser, is processed by the AI provider you choose. If you report an AI response, that response is sent to Apporo for review. Keep passwords and verification codes out of conversations.

Used for Apporo Assistant’s own connections (chat, model lists, account sign-in, MCP servers) and the in-app browser. Addresses on this phone or your local network (localhost, 192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x, names ending in .local) always connect directly. It may include user:password@, stored encrypted on this phone. Leave empty for a direct connection.
https:// proxies aren’t used for Apporo Assistant’s connections, which stay direct. Use http:// or socks5:// instead.
